answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 39224 Country: LK Title: I want to know whether I can use protection covers when having sexual intercourse with my wife Question: I want to know whether I can use protection covers when having sexual intercourse with my wife, because she underwent a creaser operation before 2 months and her Gynecologist advised not to have pregnancy upto next 1 1/2 years. So is it permissible to use tablets or condom? Please reply in English. Answer ID: 39224 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1151/965/B=1433) In the case mentioned above, you may use protection covers or contraceptives pills as per the instruction of doctor upto next one and a half year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
